company.name: German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence

profile_text.body:
The German Research Center for Artificial Intelligence, known as DFKI, is a non-profit government research lab headquartered in Kaiserslautern, Germany. On its own site the organization describes itself as recognized by the international scientific community as a major Center of Excellence in AI, and says it has focused on human-centric AI for more than 30 years, combining scientific excellence and commercially oriented value creation with social awareness.

The site also points to a current issue of its magazine covering research questions around the perception, understanding, and agency of AI systems, and carries a June 2026 item dated Paris and Berlin concerning DFKI and a French national institute for research in digital fields. No AI products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are listed for the organization.
